text: Entry 2109 adds optional chaining only at the newsgroups hint used when no identity was found. If currentHeaderData is null or undefined, that special first-NNTP-account search is skipped and the existing getIdentityForHeader fallback still selects a reply identity. The fixed accepted code keeps this guard, and the NNTP account lookup itself also permits no matching account. This is a case where absent display metadata is allowed; it does not justify optional chaining on a required initialized object elsewhere. The commit title reports a regression from Bug 11076. No standalone file/news reply, identity-selection, compose-window, keyboard or runtime test was reproduced. Full bug/review context is pending.
title: Allow an absent displayed-header hint while preserving reply identity fallback
